description: Review the project or the current changes against the team standards and fix them

Review this project against the team standards.

1. Run the `standards-check` skill and fix every finding in files that are part of the current work.
2. Review what the script cannot judge: single-responsibility classes, constants not duplicated, notebooks delegating logic to `src/`, partition filters in queries, chart titles stating the insight.
3. Report: findings fixed, findings left with the reason, and the final compliance score.
